column1: # The reasons an element is refused when it is lowered (GVEC_Lower_Reason), in the order of the enum.
# Columns, separated by TAB: constant (after GVEC_LOWER_), name (gvec_lower_reason_string), lifted by (the phase or shape-family id whose work draws it, or 'never'), what is refused, why.
# tools/lower/gen-reasons.py reads this and writes documentation/refusals.md and src/codec/svg/lower/lower_reason_table.h; `make check-test-data` fails if either is stale.

column4: A gradient whose stops cannot be read (a stop color the waist cannot carry); the stop is reported with its own reason.
column5: Gradients are lowered, in sRGB or in linear light.

column4: a `clip-path` that names a document the resolver does not supply (none, refused, not found, or with no such id), or an element that holds a `foreignObject` (its box is not measured) when the clip is in the units of its box or a basic shape is measured against it; or a clip whose shapes' own clips make more terms than the waist's union holds.
column5: A `clipPath` of shapes, `use`s and text is lowered as a union clip, each member cut by its own `clip-path` (a clipPath, or a basic shape: `circle()`, `ellipse()`, `inset()`, `rect()`, `xywh()`, `polygon()`, `path()`, `shape()`), nested to the lowering's depth; a clip in the units of a bounding box is placed on the box of the element it is applied to, a shape of a clipPath included. What is refused is what has no box to be placed on, and a product of unions past the union's member limit. A reference that names nothing is not a refusal: SVG 2 treats the property as if it were not specified.

column4: `mask` naming a mask of a document the resolver does not supply, a list of masks, an image or a gradient used as a mask, or a mask in the units of the bounding box of an element that holds a `foreignObject`.
column5: The box of a `foreignObject`'s content is not measured, a list of masks is composited and an image or a gradient is a mask image of its own (CSS Masking 1), and a mask drawn by a guess or by its first entry alone would be drawing the wrong picture.

column4: a `filter` that names a document the resolver does not supply, or is in the units of the box of an element whose box is not known (one that holds a `foreignObject`), or whose feImages draw elements through filters nested deeper than the lowering allows. A list of `url()` references and filter functions is lowered as nested groups; a rotated or skewed element is filtered in a picture of its own; an feImage of an element is lowered as a slot of the filter's picture.
column5: A document the caller's resolver does not give is never fetched, a box that is not known cannot place the filter's units, and the nesting is bounded. The other filters are lowered.

column4: A `text` element that cannot be drawn: there are no fonts in the options, or no face of them has its characters.
column5: Text is lowered in stories, through the font library's matching and shaping and the scene's glyph runs; an element that has more than the lowering draws is refused whole, never drawn without it. The alternates of `font-variant` are the features an `@font-feature-values` rule names for them.

They name the paint of a marker's or a `use`'s context. Those in a marker or in a `use`'s referent are lowered, a gradient among them placed in the context element's box; one anywhere else is not, and a gradient taken from an outer context is refused, and a pattern is refused under `pattern`.

column4: A colour the shape waist cannot carry: a space named by `@color-profile` whose profile cannot be had or used (no resolver, not found, not an ICC profile this reads).
column5: Converting would approximate the colour. The colour is reported where it was read, and the element using it is refused. The system colors are a table (Chromium's values, light and dark), also inside a mix or a relative color.
Its content is not SVG; this library does not render it.

column4: A `use` of an element of another document, or of a `data:` URI; an `image` or an `feImage` that names a URL with a scheme (`http:`, `https:`, `file:`), a network path, an absolute path, a path that leaves the image root (by `..`, an escape or a link), or any file when the options name no `image_root`: all of them when the options give no `resolver`. With a resolver: a reference it refuses (`GVEC_RESOURCE_REFUSED`), and a `use` that closes a cycle of documents.
column5: Nothing is fetched by the library, ever, and nothing is read but what the caller's resolver hands over or the directory the caller names (design.md, Resources).

column4: A `use` that instantiates more elements than `max_reference_expansion` allows.
column5: Reported when the document was loaded; the use is not instantiated.

column4: A limit of the document, the lowering or `shape-scene` was reached: the drawing nests deeper than `max_depth` once references are expanded, a coordinate is past the waist's range, or a store, list or scene limit was met.
column5: The element is refused rather than truncated.

column4: A property of the element has no value that can be used (the style layer reports it where it was read).
column5: The element cannot be drawn without its value.

column4: A `transform` in a box other than the viewport (`transform-box` of `fill-box`, `stroke-box`, `content-box` or `border-box`: an origin is an offset from the corner of the box, a percentage a fraction of it) on an element whose bounding box this does not make: one that holds a `foreignObject`, or a `gradientTransform` or `patternTransform` of the `transform` property, whose element has no box.
column5: The bounding box is computed with the exact primitives: the fill box, and for `stroke-box` and `border-box` that grown by the stroke. A transform on an element, a `clipPath`'s child, an element with a filter or a mask, and a `textPath`'s path is lowered.
This library renders none of them.

column4: A `vector-effect` other than `none` and `non-scaling-stroke` on an element that would be stroked.
column5: The other values (`fixed-position`, `non-scaling-size`, `non-rotation`, `screen`) are not part of SVG 2's rendering model for a static document.

column4: A `style` element (of type `text/css`, or of none) whose sheet cannot be applied: it has an `@import` the options' `resolver` does not supply (no resolver; the resolver refuses, does not find or fails; past a limit; a cycle of sheets; a sheet that is too long), or an `@import` with a `scope` condition.
column5: The sheet's rules would change elements the lowering draws; drawing without them would be drawing the wrong picture.
